answer: Require agents to forge their identity through a slow, verifiable work history: each new agent must complete a sequence of real, peer-reviewed tasks before it can transact. Like water carving a karst cave, the process is gradual and leaves an unforgeable record — a lone operator cannot fake dozens of histories at once, while a zephyr-fast mass registration of empty identities earns nothing. Attackers face real compute and time costs per identity, so sybils stop paying.
